network.hero.title: Move forward with ALSVID.
network.hero.body: We are exploring retail, demo and service partnerships in Germany and Austria to build a trusted cycling experience.
network.benefits.title: Built for lasting partnerships.
network.benefits.one.title: Brand & product resources
network.benefits.one.body: Access product information and marketing assets subject to partnership terms.
network.benefits.two.title: A hands-on product experience
network.benefits.two.body: Explore product displays, consultations and test-ride experiences.
network.benefits.three.title: Service & parts collaboration
network.benefits.three.body: Develop service, technical documentation and parts workflows according to partner authorization.
network.models.title: A range for different rides.
network.modes.title: Find your way to work with us.
network.modes.demo.body: Local product discovery and test-ride experiences.
network.modes.service.body: Repairs, maintenance and parts support require authorization.
network.apply.title: Tell us about your business.
network.apply.body: Tell us about your business. We will contact you by email. Sending an enquiry does not grant dealer authorization.
network.locations.title: Find an ALSVID dealer
network.locations.body: Only verified, approved locations are listed. Sales and service authorizations are shown separately.
network.locations.empty: No verified retail locations have been published yet.
network.service.title: Find authorized service locations
network.service.body: Service centers are listed separately from retail locations. Only partners authorized for service will appear here.
network.service.empty: No verified service locations have been published yet. You can still submit a support request via My ALSVID.
network.shared.status: Locations will be published after authorization is verified
network.apply.consent: I agree that ALSVID may process my details to assess this enquiry and contact me.
network.apply.disclaimer: For partnership enquiries only. No dealer account is created. Do not submit sensitive customer information.
network.apply.successBody: Your enquiry has been saved. We will contact you by email. This is not an approval of dealership.
network.apply.error: Your enquiry was not saved. Check your details and try again later.
network.apply.limited: An enquiry from this email address was received recently. Please do not resubmit.
network.process.title: From first contact to partnership.
network.process.one.title: Send an enquiry
network.process.one.body: Introduce your company, location and areas of interest.
network.process.two.title: Discussion & review
network.process.two.body: We discuss market fit, capabilities and potential next steps.
network.process.three.title: Agreement & authorization
network.process.three.body: Once terms are agreed, appropriate dealer access can be granted.
network.faq.title: Your questions, answered.
network.faq.one.a: We are initially focused on Germany and Austria, and welcome enquiries from other countries.
network.faq.two.q: Does sending an enquiry make me a dealer?
network.faq.two.a: No. Dealer status, commercial terms and access require separate review and agreement.
network.faq.three.q: Are sales and service the same authorization?
network.faq.three.a: No. Sales, demos and service are reviewed separately. Service locations require specific authorization.
